Form: Single or divorced? Just filled official form in online & it asks marital status Usually I’d put divorced. But that was 15 years ago! When are you allowed to say single? (heard this apparently matters for car insurance, but don’t see why it matters on other forms)

Had gestational diabetes, so at risk of actual diabetes - therefore try to lose weight But whenever I increase my exercise levels, my back goes Any weight loss then returns, due to movement being limited for weeks 😕 Going to try tai chi, as it’s supposed to be gentle on backs

I joined the Ramblers one year but I never managed a ramble I couldn’t get passed anxiety of: • trying something new • thought of having to chat with people • probably getting lost (physically not be able to complete a whole walk, so would have had to find my own way back)

Manager asked if I was ok for meeting at 11:30 I said ‘yes’ my heart sank instantly 11:30 is my lunch time 😩 #ActuallyAutistic Colleague realised - & started singing ‘Let if go’ Manager came over ...and somehow I got courage to ask to change meeting to later time 😀🎉✨
When you tell someone you don’t like physical contact and then they spend the rest of the day deliberately touching you That’s just wrong 🙁 #ActuallyAutistic

Unusual day: • stood up for myself against someone touching me • facebook had ‘memory’ of my mom from 7 years ago (love you, RIP) • Just started application for a role likely beyond me, but thought ‘sod it’ • horror at receiving court papers for appeal All feels bit unreal
I’m not aware of any new info about PIP 🤔 Had their court papers this week, so I guess it’ll continue
Photo taken today of me relaxing on holiday 😅

Quite pleased to have been the hero this time✨ Couple nights ago I had most of West Midlands Police Force chasing me for multiple murders 🏃🏻‍♀️🚓 I’d not killed anyone, but was set up by a bent copper ...tho’ I did happen to be a criminal mastermind 🤫 #OnlyDreaming

Civil War about to start after I inadvertently did a rousing speech Few weeks before our people were invited to join their world. But was a ruse to find us out & kill us. ...wonder if my mind is recreating what can feel a battle against autistics #OnlyDreaming #ActuallyAutistic

Woke feeling surprise and adrenaline Surprise because after my speech - meant as a peptalk, not a call to arms - very quickly thousands more arrived. I hadn’t realised so many had managed to survive by hiding away Adrenaline as thousands of us were about to embark on a battle
Saw the Doctor get married half hour ago 🤗

Relationships are difficult. Sending 💜

Support group at work for autistic people - but communication is via group phone call😱 Last time I couldn't work out when to speak #ActuallyAutistic But today I did speak - I stuttered & got my words in the wrong order - but I did speak, & they knew what I was trying to say 😊

Awww 😫 when I replied Orlando Bloom, my brain was screaming Martin Freeman at me But I ignored the screams! 😂🤣 Oh well. That’ll teach me to trust my brain a little more. *just as an aside, in 30 seconds I will press ‘send’ on a finished job application 🤞

Was asked today if mom watched my talk at autism event Person had momentarily forgot she died in March Often I do not easily identify facial expression #ActuallyAutistic but on this occasion I could see he was obviously upset on realising his mistake

Been asked to write a short article about autism for work’s ‘wellbeing’ update #ActuallyAutistic Thinking I’ll maybe not put much personal info, but instead write what things may help autistic people in the workplace 🤔 (with caveat that we’re all different) Thoughts?
I’m happy to pick up any worms and move them to 420 metres away 👍

Back in school days, teacher threatened I’d lose place in netball team because I didn’t do shooting practice with other girls at lunchtime😧 Teacher didn’t know I actually practiced on my own for many hours, aiming at a single air-brick on back wall at home✨ #ActuallyAutistic

I’m the worst at directions and geography ...geographical dyslexia maybe 🤔 School even refused to let me carry on with geography after one year because I was so bad 😱 But unlike the BBC, I do know that Nottingham is not London way 😅
I’m trying to ignore the world - by that, I specifically mean brexit news. I’m in an odd ‘place’ today, where some parts are immeasurably awful and other parts are teasingly hopeful 🤷‍♀️

Went to new memorial to victims of 1974 Birmingham pub bombings Steel branches, with names on leaves It seemed just right. Also it’s at main entrance to train station so lots people will see it. Several were there respectfully looking Somehow it didn’t feel right to take photo
Last summer being so hot for a long time meant I was in shorts and vest top for months Was quite pleased when I could get back into my joggers 😅
I’ve added on app to do back exercises three times a week. In past I did try just using phone reminder, but found it too easy to ignore
Twitter Cycles 🤔 I was an avid twitter user - to help my mental health And now I’ve much reduced my twitter usage - to help my mental health

Change #ActuallyAutistic This is my 15th home - I’m used to moving This time I seem to have settled. Been here ten years But not redecorated ..even still have the previous residents curtains😲 As I don’t like: • this type of change • decorating smells • people in my house
- there’s now an anti-bullying pledge for everyone to sign up to me: where do you sign? - you don’t sign anything me: 😶 #ActuallyAutistic
Oh and land mines Jelly fish invasion and bombs rolling onto beaches

Properties have repeated in dreams thru life Guess state of house reflects my general wellbeing For long time my homes were eg falling down, or flooded or other disaster Last night - little difficult to get in initially, but then my home was great & it made me feel so happy 🤗
I’ve been brave... and now need to not think about it 😶 Booked onto a short course in May - Art Introductory Course Don’t want my anxieties to stop me from going 🤞 #ActuallyAutistic

Had the best week ✨ expecting the worst as it’s first anniversary of mom’s death But got: • organisation to change info on their autism page • did presentation that was well received • got bit extra in pay as thank you for something else Think mom was watching out for me😊
I’ve lost a lot Still going through courts, such a long drawn out process
